name: Billy Maclure
summary: At Maclure Vineyards, Billy Maclure's pranks stir trouble between two neighboring farms. The young human boy dodges chores and plays at the feud between his family and the Stonefields, but fresh pastries can win his cooperation.

sections.title: A Boy at the Vineyards
sections.body: Billy Maclure spends his days outside the barn at Maclure Vineyards, near farmer Gerard Tiller. He grows up among the grapevines in southern Elwynn Forest, often dodging chores and roaming the meadows. The Maclures and Stonefields have long been hostile toward each other. Billy treats their feud as a chance for pranks and petty theft.

sections.title: The Stolen Necklace
sections.body: Billy Maclure stole Auntie Bernice Stonefield's treasured heirloom necklace. While running near Fargodeep Mine, he lost hold of it. Goldtooth, a massive and vicious kobold, snatched the necklace and vanished into the mine's tunnels. Billy fears the kobolds and the neighboring elders' anger, so he hesitates to confess. Auntie Bernice's hot pork belly pie can coax the truth from him.

faq.answer: Billy Maclure is a young human boy at Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. He dodges farm work, plays pranks, and aggravates the neighboring Stonefields.

faq.q: Where can Billy Maclure be found?
faq.answer: Billy waits outside the main barn at Maclure Vineyards, in southern Elwynn Forest east of Stonefield Farm.

faq.q: What did Billy do to Auntie Bernice?
faq.answer: Billy stole Auntie Bernice Stonefield's heirloom necklace during the feud between their families.

faq.q: What happened to the necklace Billy stole?
faq.answer: Billy lost the necklace near Fargodeep Mine. Goldtooth picked it up and carried it into the mine.

faq.q: How do you get Billy to confess what happened to the necklace?
faq.answer: Offer Billy a freshly baked pork belly pie from Auntie Bernice. His appetite can coax him to confess.
Goldtooth is an exceptionally large and vicious kobold leader in Fargodeep Mine. He took Auntie Bernice's necklace near the mine entrance and keeps it in the tunnels.

angles.text: As a human, Billy's troubles show the everyday quarrels of the Elwynn countryside. Farm feuds and childhood mischief continue amid Stormwind's political turmoil.
As an Alliance adventurer newly arrived from Northshire, helping with Billy's pranks introduces you to dangers in Fargodeep Mine.
As a cook, you can see how Auntie Bernice's pork belly pie helps settle local disputes and coax confessions from tight-lipped farm boys.
